synopsis.text: When the Kingpin orders that J. Jonah Jameson be silenced for his negative press on Fisk's illegal activites, Spidey swings in to save the EIC. But can the Wallcrawler take the big guy in a one-on-one brawl?

After exiting the hero game last issue as far as we know it, Peter walks away from being Spider-man The Kingpin has just organized all crime. The Kingpin however wants Daily Bugle editor J. Jonah Jameson quieted due to his articles.Meahwhile some thugs go to rob a service station and are intervened by the returning Spider-man. The Kingpin has more plans andneeds Fredrick Foswell for plans which has not yet been revealed. The hoods who got away from Spidey head back and interrupt letting the Kingpin know of Spidey's return. For barging in on him the "Pin give the guys what's coming to them.Meanwhile peter heads back to get his job back at the Daily Bugle and gets it back. Later as Spidey he see's some more crime happening and breaks that up too. Back at the Bugle some of Kingpins men kidnap Jameson and take him to the hideout. Spidey having placed a spider-tracer on one of the hoods also heads there. Of course Spidey manages to get the thugs in webs except for the Kingpin. They fight and Kingpin wins this round by gassing our hero.
